merge to 87166

Move all the telemetry that uses GetInventoryInformation command to Inventory.cpp file and remove it from here.  Let Inventory class be a place for all inventory properties. If we need to update a common dbus interface from this class and Inventory class than create the interface in Device class and pass it as constructor parameter to both the classes.

Done. Removed fetchMemoryCapacity() from NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice. MAX_MEMORY_CAPACITY is now queried through Inventory::registerDramInventory() using the existing Inventory pipeline with retry. The dramItemInterface is created in NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice and passed to Inventory via GpuDevice.

See PS5: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/5/src/nvidia-gpu/Inventory.cpp#94 https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/5/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp#67
This is not done. Please create dbus interface in Device class and pass it as constructor parameter to both the Inventory class and NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice class.

Sorry for missing. Moved dramItemInterface creation from NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice to GpuDevice constructor, and pass it as constructor parameter to both Inventory and NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice. Removed registerDramInventory() method and getDramItemInterface() getter.

See PS10:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/10/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp#67
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/10/src/nvidia-gpu/Inventory.cpp#43
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/10/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice.cpp#31
This is not needed.

Done, thanks.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/6..10/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice.hpp#b39
You should use https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Inventory/Connector/Embedded.interface.yaml

Thanks for the suggestion. Added
xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Connector.Embedded
marker interface to NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice for DRAM
objects.

See PS17:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/12..17/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice.cpp#54
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/12..17/src/nvidia-gpu/NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice.hpp#50
Does existing bmcweb implementation consume this interface?

Not yet in current upstream, but the paired bmcweb change https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/87974 (same topic: GPU_Memory_Inventory) consumes this interface to identify embedded DRAM memory under GPU processors.
Why is this patch removing existing comments?

Sorry, that was mistake. Restored in the latest patch set. Thanks for catching it.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87975/20..21
With new Item.Dram interface, do we really need this?

Thanks Harshit. The Connector.Embedded interface is consumed by the companion bmcweb patch 87974 (topic GPU_Memory_Inventory). When present on the DRAM object, bmcweb sets Location.PartLocation.LocationType to "Embedded" in the Redfish Memory resource.

That said, if Item.Dram alone is sufficient to determine the location type, I can remove Connector.Embedded once the Item.Dram PDI approach is finalized.

Splitting patches that share an Inventory-updated interface (like dramItemInterface) creates confusion about where the interface should be declared (NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice vs GpuDevice). 

Suggest keeping this and 87166 together in one patch, like https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/87017 did for powerCapInterface.

Not blocking.
Still keep two patch but move interface to NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice, thanks.

Our code style is that objects that need update() are done in makeSensors. Sorry, my original comment may have caused confusion — what I meant was that interfaces used by both Inventory and another object class should be declared in NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp. Because in your previous patch 87166 there was no indication you needed Inventory, that's why I suggested in 87166 not to declare dramIfaceName in NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp — since that patch had no Inventory, and this patch is the one that does. That's also why I suggested merging the two patches together, so it would be clear why you originally declared dramIfaceName in NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp.

You've now moved the dramIfaceName declaration into NvidiaGpuMemoryDevice.cpp in 87166 — could you move it back to NvidiaGpuDevice.cpp in 87975? Sorry for the misleading. 
Thanks.
Let's add it back here.
We need dramItemInterface = objectServer.add_interface(dramPath, dramIfaceName); here because of Inventory class need it.
